name: iNaturalist taxonomy
license: facts uncopyrightable (Feist); identifiers and scientific names only
note: A crosswalk target, not a taxonomic authority: ADR-0008 keeps taxon_id on NCBI precisely because iNaturalist's taxonomy is crowd-edited and shifts. SalishSea.io ingests iNaturalist sightings, so this is the mapping that lets an observation's taxon resolve to a register entity. No observation data is imported, so per-observation licences do not arise.
